Sky Glass Air projects deep, crisp sound that suits whatever you're watching.

Sky Glass Air comes in three colours and sizes, so it looks great in any room you choose.

Slim, lightweight and with a bright 4K picture, Sky’s low-
cost TV shines because of its software and service.

Sky Glass Air has a 4K HDR Quantum Dot screen and a Dolby Audio speaker system. It even auto-adjusts your picture and sound based on what you're watching, whether that's jaw-dropping documentaries or much-loved movies.

Sky OS is the intelligent software that powers our much-loved TV experience. It brings your entertainment from Sky and other apps into one place, and it keeps on getting smarter, with new features that get you to what you want to watch, faster.
With a 4K HDR Quantum Dot screen, Sky Glass Air gives you a vibrant picture packed full of colour.
More of the UK's highest rated shows, with Sky, Netflix and discovery+ from £15 a month.
Get a crisp and clear picture, with 4x the detail of HD.
